title: Get state and post to page

comments.body:
Hi, before the upgrade which routing system was in place? The modern implementation: `routing` or the legacy one: `urlSync`? I ask the question because the two system does not use the same strategy for the serialization of the URL. The output of `getQueryStringFromState` is not compatible with the modern `routing` system. We don't use the Helper anymore to generate the URL. Those functions on the Helper are deprecated and will be removed in the next major.

InstantSearch exposes on its instance a top-level function called `createURL`. This function has almost the same purpose than the function you're using. You should be able to use it rather than the legacy `getQueryStringFromState` function. Here is [an example](https://codesandbox.io/embed/instantsearchjs-showcase-usage-of-createurl-9t1d9) that showcase both usage side by side.

Hey @samouss, thanks for the reply (sorry for taking so long to get back to you!). 

Ah, we were using urlSync so I see what you mean and thanks for the example too. Much appreciated. I'll have a good read and check it out.
